messages:
jin: quick heads-up: nova11b-int4 canary showing rare OOMs when max_new_tokens>180 and microbatch large. Posting minimal repro and logs.
rosa: paste run id and config?
jin: run=nova-canary-6182 config=batch=3 microbatch=512k max_new_tokens=256 prefetch=on kv=yes quant=perchannel-int4
logs:
```
[2026-03-23T17:05:03Z] ERROR allocator: cudaOutOfMemoryError allocate 1.9GB
[2026-03-23T17:05:03Z] WARN mem-frag: free-list larger-than-threshold 1.1GB
[2026-03-23T17:05:04Z] INFO evict: soft-evict reclaimed 160MB
```
sam: looks like fragmentation during long-gen. quick fixes: reduce max_new_tokens default to 128 for canary, lower microbatch to 256k, and enable earlier soft-evict (threshold 512MB).
jin: applying microbatch=256k & soft_evict=512MB now. infra-bot will roll nodes.
infra-bot: patching nova-canary-6182 configs: microbatch=256k soft_evict_threshold=512MB rolling-restart nodes [gpu-d4-01]
rosa: also run targeted quant-calib including long-gen prompts and number-heavy prompts (math/date) with kl+mse. that helped earlier models.
sam: add metric "longgen-success" (percentage of runs that reach >200 tokens without OOM) to gate.
jin: kicked eval eval-nova-long-6182, will post results in ~15m. thanks.
